name: Compact Electric Car
blurb: Efficient, quiet, and the cheapest thing in the shop.

name: Limited-Edition Hypercar
blurb: One of twelve ever made. You now own one.

name: Private Jet
blurb: No boarding groups. No overhead bin fights.

name: Fleet of 1,000 Electric Semi Trucks
blurb: You are now, unofficially, a logistics company.

name: Luxury Superyacht
blurb: Comes with a smaller yacht, for the yacht.

name: Historic European Castle
blurb: Moat optional. Drafty hallways included.

name: Manhattan-Style Penthouse
blurb: Floor-to-ceiling windows, sky-high property tax.

name: Private Caribbean Island
blurb: Your own postal code, basically.

name: Antarctic Research Station
blurb: The most exclusive zip code on Earth.

name: Landmark Skyscraper
blurb: The whole building. Elevator etiquette now your problem.

name: A National Coffee Chain
blurb: Free lattes, forever, for exactly one person: you.

name: A Professional Basketball Team
blurb: Courtside seat included. Championships not guaranteed.

name: A Movie Studio
blurb: Greenlight your own biopic. Just saying.

name: A Video Game Publisher
blurb: You can finally fix the ending everyone hated.

name: A Social Media Platform
blurb: Free speech, expensive server bill.

name: Private Seat to the Space Station
blurb: The ultimate window seat.

name: Orbital Rocket Launch
blurb: One trip to orbit, please.

name: Broadband Satellite Constellation
blurb: Wi-Fi in places Wi-Fi should not exist.

name: Moon Lander Program
blurb: One small step, one enormous invoice.

name: Full Mars Colony Mission
blurb: The single biggest line item in the shop.

name: Lifetime Supply of Energy Drinks
blurb: You will not sleep again. Worth it.

name: Life-Size Chocolate Statue of Yourself
blurb: Melts in summer. A metaphor, probably.

name: Solid Gold Toilet
blurb: The most expensive bathroom break in history.

name: A Herd of 1,000 Alpacas
blurb: No business reason. Just alpacas.

name: Life-Size Replica Pyramid
blurb: Archaeologists will be so confused in 3,000 years.
